text: 金十数据11月3日讯，十四届全国人大常委会第二十五次会议3日上午在北京人民大会堂举行第二次全体会议。会议听取了中国人民银行行长潘功胜受国务院委托作的关于金融工作情况的报告。报告介绍了2025年10月以来金融工作主要进展及成效、当前经济金融形势和问题挑战，提出下一步工作考虑：继续实施好适度宽松的货币政策，为经济持续向新向优向好发展营造适宜的货币金融环境；进一步加强和完善金融监管，不断增强监管质效；实施好支持资本市场的货币政策工具，巩固完善资本市场稳市机制。维护股票、债券、外汇等金融市场平稳运行，守住不发生系统性金融风险底线。（新华社）
text_en: Jinshi Data, November 3: The 25th session of the Standing Committee of the 14th National People's Congress held its second plenary meeting on the morning of the 3rd at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing. The meeting heard a report on financial work delivered by PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng on behalf of the State Council. The report covered the main progress and results of financial work since October 2025, the current economic and financial situation and challenges, and set out next steps: continue to implement a moderately loose monetary policy to create a suitable monetary and financial environment for the economy's sustained development toward innovation, improvement and positive momentum; further strengthen and improve financial regulation, continuously enhancing regulatory quality and effectiveness; implement monetary policy tools supporting the capital market and consolidate and improve the capital market stabilization mechanism. Maintain the smooth operation of stock, bond, foreign exchange and other financial markets, and hold the bottom line of preventing systemic financial risks. (Xinhua)
